links.outcome: Readability grade level of LLM-generated clinic letters versus recommended sixth-grade target
links.effect: ChatGPT4 letters with complication profiles had average readability grades between eighth and ninth, above the targeted sixth-grade level.
links.quote: ChatGPT4 achieved the highest compliance in integrating complication profiles from BAAPS and ASPS websites, with average readability grades between eighth and ninth.

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial LLMs (ChatGPT-4, ChatGPT-3.5, Google Bard) on their baseline ability to generate outpatient clinic letters incorporating standard surgical complication profiles, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
